title: The receipt that counted twice
summary: A portable public projection of an original duplicate-receipt repair performed by one real historical Astra continuation: unchanged utility and criteria, redacted derived evidence, reproducible source snapshots, and a Pocket Arcade maintenance export.
limitations: Clean-room reproduction of the seed's explicitly specified ll-duplicate defect, not an upstream patch or newly discovered bug.
Original SYNTHETIC fixtures only; no real telemetry, player feedback, human review, or production assurance.

One real separate Astra continuation performed the original repair. Private invocation records and identity are withheld; this historical fact cannot be independently reverified from the public projection.
Public historical records are explicitly redacted derivatives, not byte-identical private transcripts or new executions. Original numerical observations and safe input bytes are retained.
Historical commit hashes are informational; checks use included source snapshots and current public-byte hashes, never private Git objects.
The browser plays back captured Python output; the Python utility runs separately through the documented CLI.
Browser visuals were not browser-validated; DOM behavior and static offline references are tested with Node built-ins.
The seed's separate ordering defect was not an unfinished defect here; this is not the full seed release gate.
The maintenance artifact is provided for a consumer; integration into another workstream is not claimed.
No network dependencies, services, native Hive activation, or release authority. Only the coordinating publisher owns remote publication; this projection performs no remote operations.
